SELECT hst.MSG_TP , date_format(hst.send_req_day, '%Y-%m') AS send_mon , Sum(hst.send_cnt) AS total_cnt , SUM( CAST((cd.cd_desc * hst.send_cnt) AS DECIMAL(12,1))) AS total_cost , team.LIST_NM FROM tblmire_send_hst AS hst LEFT JOIN tblmicp_program AS prg ON prg.PRO_ID = hst.PRO_ID LEFT JOIN tblmicp_campaign AS camp ON camp.PRO_ID = hst.PRO_ID AND camp.seq = hst.camp_id LEFT JOIN tblmi_set_lst AS team ON team.LIST_TP_ID = 'CH05' AND team.LIST_DT_ID = 'TEAM01' AND team.LIST_VAL = camp.TEAM_CD AND team.USR_GRP_CD = camp.USR_GRP_CD LEFT JOIN tblmi_comm_cd AS cd ON cd.grp_id = 'API_PRICE' AND cd.cd_id = hst.usr_grp_cd AND cd.cd_val = hst.msg_tp
hst.send_rst = '0' AND hst.usr_grp_cd = #{usr_grp_cd} AND hst.send_req_day IS NOT null AND hst.msg_tp is not null
AND prg.pro_nm like concat('%', #{pro_nm}, '%')
AND team.LIST_NM like concat('%', #{team_nm}, '%')
AND hst.send_req_day >= #{start_dt}
AND hst.send_req_day <= #{end_dt}
AND (hst.send_req_day >= DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(#{monthly_dt}), INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL -1 MONTH) and hst.send_req_day < DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(#{monthly_dt}), INTERVAL 1 DAY))
GROUP BY send_mon , hst.msg_tp ORDER BY hst.send_req_day,hst.pro_id
